You heard directly from Carlos Ruiz (Master Mechanic): Reach out to Mark Thompson at the high school auto shop. Not to ask for anything specific — just to make contact, find out what his EV curriculum looks like, and let him know I am doing the EVT Level 2 certification. Open a professional bridge. He may know things about the local EV service landscape that I do not. And if there is ever a part-time teaching opportunity on EV systems down the road, I want my name to be in his head.

You heard directly from Sarah Kim (Junior Mechanic): Reach out to Mark Thompson, the auto shop teacher at Millfield High, to introduce myself and ask about his EV battery and charging certification program. Frame it as a fellow practitioner wanting to understand the curriculum — not as a student asking for help. See if there's overlap with my EVT Level 1 coursework, access to their lab equipment, or a chance to do some informal cross-training.
